answers.answer: Total revenue decreased by $2,878,382 thousand (23%), from $12,305,539 thousand to $9,427,157 thousand. The company says this was mainly due to weaker macroeconomic trends. The effect was strongest in Industrial, where customers reduced their inventory balances, and in Communications, because of the timing of infrastructure deployment cycles. Automotive and Consumer fell less, as demand weakened with reduced consumer spending. Revenue fell in all regions for the same macroeconomic reasons.
